messages.author: Ross Walker
messages.body:
Hi Amberites,
Exxact have just posted an updated list of benchmarks for Amber 24/25. They include the RTX Pro 4500, RTX Pro 6000 MaxQ, RTX5070, 5080, 5090, GH200 and B200. RTX Pro 6000 and RTX Pro 5000 numbers will be coming soon.
https://www.exxactcorp.com/blog/molecular-dynamics/amber-molecular-dynamics-nvidia-gpu-benchmarks
All the best
Ross
